summary: Optimization: Migrate Video Engine to expo-video

details.user_story: As a Developer, I want to use the latest expo-video library so that the app remains compatible with future Expo SDK versions and benefits from native performance improvements.
details.context: expo-av is deprecated for video as of SDK 52/53. Transitioning to the new VideoPlayer API will improve sync reliability and future-proof the codebase.
acceptance_criteria: Sync Parity: Ensure the `timeUpdate` listener correctly triggers the SkeletonOverlay landmark updates.
Stability: Verify that video looping and native controls function identically to the previous version.
technical_details: Use `useVideoPlayer` hook for state-driven playback control.
Update `handlePlaybackStatusUpdate` logic to the new `timeUpdate` event listener format.
Map `player.src` metadata to the coordinate scaling logic.
edge_cases: Fast Scrubbing: Ensure the skeleton doesn't lag when the user drags the video progress bar.
Backgrounding: Handle app suspension to ensure the video player doesn't leak memory.
